profile.headline: Software Engineer | GCP | vGHC'21 | MSCS @ UTD | Ex-TCS
profile.summary:
I am a highly motivated and skilled Computer Science graduate from the University of Texas at Dallas and Cochin University of Science and Technology. I have gained extensive experience in developing robust software solutions and implementing dynamic web applications. My proficiency in various programming languages such as Java11, Python, C++, Typescript, Javascript, HTML5, and CSS, coupled with my knowledge of frameworks including Spring Boot, Hibernate JPA, Bootstrap, Angular, and ReactJS, has enabled me to excel in various software development roles. In addition to this, I have also honed my skills in cloud computing, particularly with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

I am the recipient of various awards and scholarships, including the GHC Scholarship in 2021 and the Best New Joiner Award at Tata Consultancy Services (Singapore Airlines) in 2019.

I am a passionate and dedicated individual who is always willing to learn and explore new technologies to deliver innovative and reliable software solutions. I am looking for challenging opportunities to further hone my skills and make a positive impact in the industry.
 
Experience
Has 4 years of professional work experience with a demonstrated history of working in Computer Software industry.

Languages and tools - Java11, C++, C, Python, GCP, Typescript, Javascript, CSS, HTML5, JIRA, Git, SVN

Frameworks - React JS, Angular, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA

Databases - MySQL, DynamoDB, BigQuery

Soft Skills
Team Player, Problem solver, Quick learner, Efficient communication, Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and deployed applications to Google Cloud Run that publish and subscribes to Google pub/sub.
- Created Monitors and Dashboard for cloud run apps and google pub/sub topics and subscriptions with Datadog.
- Used Jinjava for JSON transformation.
- Worked with Bigquery dataset, created a scheduled task to expire messages stored after 180 days
- Added terraform configuration for GCP changes
positions.insights: Java, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Worked on the Warehouse Execution System project of the company and created CRUD operations in handling event-driven services.
- Developed postman scripts to automate the testing process.
- Used RabbitMQ as messaging backbone to handle high volumes of data, with Kibana providing real-time monitoring, analysis.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible to create DAO CRUD methods using Hibernate and Spring boot framework.
- Worked with Angular 2/9 modules, routing, templates, directives, and services.
- Worked upon ReactJS framework to design web pages.
+Tech Stacks: Java 8, Spring Boot, Hibernate, HQL, ReactJS, Angular 2/9, HTML5, CSS

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on CMS project of the company.
- Implemented functionality to compare similarities of two databases.
- Developed functionality to convert encoded image format to image URLs. 
- Implemented functionality to upload images to S3.
+Tech Stacks: Python, Django
positions.insights: SQL, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +4 skills
